scope: Evidence prerequisite review and limited conditional manufacturer screening; no governing code selected and no full code predicate evaluated.
missing_evidence_policy: UNRESOLVED, never PASS and never automatically a proven violation.

checks.observation: All street addresses are placeholders; source coordinates and postal fields conflict. The public repository does not establish the project address, permit date or governing code.
checks.required: Authenticated location, authority, permit/design dates, occupancy/clinical uses, adopted editions, amendments and healthcare obligations.

checks.area: Pipe, duct and electrical containment products
checks.observation: All 19,352 IFC4 service segments lack direct/type material and property-set assignments. All purchasing groups lack a verified specification or product match. Family names and pricing proxies do not authenticate wall thickness, gauge, listing or service suitability.
checks.required: Project material schedules and exact product specifications, service/pressure/temperature ratings, listings and compatible fittings.

checks.observation: The broad scenario assumes 3,457 additional joints: HVAC 2,591, plumbing 286, sprinkler 474, electrical containment 106. Joint positions, end preparation, engagement, tolerances, support changes and installed performance have not been validated.
checks.required: Fabrication details tied to actual specified products and tools; account for fitting take-up and losses; check supports, clearance, accessibility and applicable inspection/testing.

checks.observation: The splitter creates 149 new tails below 100 mm; the shortest is a 3 mm round-duct piece (#842498). Sprinkler #167783 creates a 90 mm grooved-label tail, below the cited Victaulic tool-specific 205 mm roll-grooving minimum. Actual supplier/tool applicability is not established; neither threshold is a universal code limit.
checks.required: Select actual products and tools, enforce their minimum finished-piece and end requirements, and rebalance or retain affected spans. See proposals/manufacturer-screen.json for exact source identity and manufacturer reference.

checks.observation: No explicit IfcSpace/IfcZone objects, authenticated served-room schedule, complete ventilation targets, pressure/filtration requirements or whole-network design duties were established. Equipment labels are not selected operating duties.
checks.required: Room-use and volume schedule, served-room mappings, airflows and pressure relationships, filtration, fan/pump duties, duct construction class and applicable design calculations.

checks.observation: No complete service/material schedule, design flow/pressure criteria, demand calculations or drainage/venting design contract was established. Cut-length preservation is not a slope or hydraulic check.
checks.required: Service identification, fixture demands, supply conditions, sizing calculations, drainage invert/slope and vent details, backflow provisions and actual joint specifications.

checks.observation: The electrical model has 84 conduit/tray segments and no explicit IfcCableSegment objects. A complete circuit, conductor, protective-device and healthcare power design contract was not established.
checks.required: Circuit and load schedules, actual cable/conductor and containment specifications, ampacity/protection/fault data, grounding/bonding, essential-power design and equipment instructions.

checks.observation: The 1,354 sprinkler terminals have no assigned property sets/materials. The original hazard/design basis, water supply, verified sprinkler product data and hydraulic substantiation were not established; 474 added joints are assumed in the broad scenario.
checks.required: Approved original design basis, hazard/coverage data, water-supply test, sprinkler and pipe/fitting specifications and hydraulic substantiation appropriate to the proposed changes.

checks.observation: The fire model has 861 control devices without assigned property sets; the purchasing scenario does not design alarm wiring, power, coverage or cause-and-effect logic.
checks.required: Device specifications, circuit/power/battery calculations, detector/notification coverage, interfaces, cause-and-effect matrix and acceptance test requirements.

checks.area: Medical gas/vacuum and other healthcare services
checks.observation: Generic pipe labels do not establish whether each healthcare service is represented, required or appropriately specified.
checks.required: Authenticated service schedule and clinical risk classifications, applicable requirements and complete designs for required systems.

checks.observation: No structural analysis model, load groups, load objects or analysis results are embedded. Strength-like material names do not establish capacity. No new structural analysis was performed.
checks.required: Approved structural design basis/calculations, material specifications, loads and combinations, connections, support/anchorage and seismic requirements.

checks.observation: No full building-code geometry/occupancy review was performed. Fifty-five curtain-wall FireRating properties contain an ambiguous multi-rating string; it is not an authenticated installed or required assembly rating.
checks.required: Applicable occupancy and accessibility criteria, life-safety plans, compartment/assembly listings and penetration/firestop details, then dedicated geometry and documentary checks.
